title: Top Fire Doll Grace 160cm F-Cup Silicone Customizable Companion Doll
description: Grace is a made-to-order Top Fire Doll full-silicone companion doll with a 160 cm frame, an F-Cup profile, a 92 cm bust and 92 cm hips. Review the included configuration, available options, timing, and measurements before checkout.    Height:  5 ft 3 in / 160 cm   Weight:  66.1 lbs / 30 kg   Cup size:  F-Cup   Feet Length:  8 in / 20 cm   Bust:  3 ft / 92 cm   Legs Length:  3 ft 0 in / 91 cm   Waist:  2 ft 2 in / 65 cm   Arms Length:  1 ft 7 in / 47 cm   Hip:  3 ft / 92 cm   Shoulders Width:  1 ft 3 in / 39 cm   Vagina Depth:  7 in / 18 cm   Anus Depth:  6 in / 15 cm   Oral Depth:  7 in / 18 cm   Factory-made to your selected configuration, shipping from China. The base price includes one head. Motorised functions are optional factory upgrades, not standard inclusions.

editorialIntro.heading: The Solemnity of Grace
editorialIntro.paragraph: The ceremony has ended and the guests have departed, leaving Grace alone in the pale glow of the afternoon sun. She sits in a pool of diffused light, her fingers grazing her lips as she contemplates the weight of the cream lace draping her shoulders. The sheer veil obscures her dark eyes, adding a layer of mystery to her quiet, expectant expression. With a slow, deliberate motion, she reaches up to draw the fabric back, inviting you to witness her in this stolen moment of stillness. As the pearls at her neck catch the light, Grace turns her gaze toward you, ready to transform this formal devotion into a deeper, more intimate revelation.
